pattern_name: Kyriba rollout: bank connectivity before automation
when_to_apply: Do not scale treasury automation until bank formats, signer controls, SAP mappings, and rejection handling are evidenced.

pattern_name: Cash visibility: portal dependency is the risk signal
when_to_apply: If cash is still assembled from bank portals and spreadsheets, daily liquidity decisions are not automation-ready.

pattern_name: Automated close: semantic layer must cite GL and reconciliation evidence
when_to_apply: AI finance narratives need governed metric definitions and source-cited close reconciliations.

pattern_name: Finance service agent: repeated ticket themes signal automation candidates
when_to_apply: ServiceNow finance tickets can drive agent assist only when root cause, knowledge quality, and SAP/Kyriba ownership are explicit.
